name: Middle Eastern Falafel Bowl
ingredients: 4 baked falafel patties (made from ½ cup dry chickpeas, see Baked Falafel)
1 cucumber, 1 tomato and ¼ red onion, diced
Sauce: ¼ cup plain low-fat yogurt, juice of 1 lemon, 1 garlic clove (grated), mint
steps: Prepare the falafel mixture as in Baked Falafel with Yogurt Dip and bake 4 patties at 200°C for 25 minutes, turning once.
Toss the cucumber, tomato, onion and leaves with a squeeze of lemon and salt.
Divide the quinoa and salad between two bowls.
Top with the falafel and drizzle with the sauce.
note: A complete bowl; bake the falafel in advance and it reheats well.
